name: wanderers-core
description: Shared core library for cocoomg11's Foundry VTT modules, vendored and pinned into each module (no runtime dependency).

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs src/foundry/*.mjs tools/*.mjs tests/*.mjs config/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run types && npm test
